headline: Sam-wiz and ibyyue climb into ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: Sam-wiz rose from 16th to 13th and ibyyue from 19th to 14th, each reaching 41.81 as they entered the 15 gold places.
The gold cutoff climbed 2.22 in the past day to 40.83. Jack Cole, previously 15th, is now 17th and outside the gold places at 38.61.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
